prompt_latex: In electrical occupational standards, what is the calculated total current drawn by a $220\text{ V}$ circuit supplying three parallel $100\text{ W}$ resistive loads?
explanation_latex: Total power $P = 3 \times 100\text{ W} = 300\text{ W}$. Using $I = \frac{P}{V} = \frac{300}{220} \approx 1.36\text{ A}$.

prompt_latex: When performing preventive maintenance on hydraulic machinery, what is the primary diagnostic sign of hydraulic fluid aeration?
option_b: Spongy actuator response and foaming in reservoir
option_c: Higher fluid viscosity at operating temperature
explanation_latex: Aeration introduces air bubbles into hydraulic fluid, creating a spongy/erratic cylinder response and observable foam.

prompt_latex: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is considered the first line of defense in the occupational hierarchy of hazard controls.
explanation_latex: Under OSHA and international occupational safety standards, elimination and engineering controls precede PPE, which is the last line of defense.

prompt_latex: In software development competency assessments, which HTTP response status code must be returned following the successful creation of a new database resource?
explanation_latex: RFC 7231 specifies 201 Created as the standard response when an HTTP POST successfully creates one or more new resources.

prompt_latex: According to accounting standards, what is the correct journal entry to record depreciation of office equipment?
option_b: Debit Accumulated Depreciation, Credit Depreciation Expense
option_c: Debit Depreciation Expense, Credit Accumulated Depreciation
explanation_latex: Depreciation expense is recognized on the income statement with a debit, while accumulated depreciation (contra-asset) is credited.
